tools.name: check_shop_sales
tools.description: Checks whether a UK shop has a sale on today and when it ends. Returns each sale the shop is running now with its start and end dates and a link, its sales from the latest December and January, and the dates of its sales in each earlier season. From January Sales' listings of UK shops' sales all yea

tools.name: list_category_sales
tools.description: Finds which UK shops have a sale on today in one product category, such as electricals, fashion or furniture: one sale per shop, up to five, each with its start and end dates and a link. From January Sales' listings of UK shops' sales all year round.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_shop_sales" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
